job.player_partner.combat.desc: Follows you and fights hostile mobs, starting with the one you are attacking.
job.player_partner.mining.desc: Mines nearby blocks (all ores by default); drops go into the partner's backpack.
job.player_partner.chopping.desc: Chops nearby trees; the logs go into the partner's backpack.
job.player_partner.farming.desc: Plants seeds on empty farmland, or tills dirt into farmland with a hoe.
gui.player_partner.job_filter.desc: Configure per-job filters, such as which blocks to mine.
gui.player_partner.job_filter.no_filter: No filters for this job yet.
gui.player_partner.mining_filter.desc: Choose which blocks the partner may mine.
message.player_partner.skin_not_found: Player Partner: no premium account named "%s" was found. Write a correct premium ID on the name tag.
message.player_partner.skin_network_erro: Player Partner: could not reach the Minecraft skin server. Please check your network connection.
message.player_partner.skin_not_found_de: Player Partner: no premium account named "%s" was found, so the built-in default skin is used.
message.player_partner.skin_network_erro: Player Partner: the skin server is unreachable, so the built-in default skin is used for now. Write an ID on a name tag later to change it.
message.player_partner.renamed: The Player Partner is now called: %s (skin updated)
message.player_partner.need_player: This command can only be run by a player.
message.player_partner.limit: The partner limit (%s) has been reached. Change partnerLimit in the config file.
